rawContent: Thank you @DrewBarrymore and @BrookeShields This conversation is powerful and will resonate with so many survivors. The situational grooming. The self-blame. The shame. The confusion of a child victim or of an adult victim who was also abused as a child. This is profound. #MeToo

If it weren't for Twitter, I wouldn't have found the courage to say #MeToo or a platform to address the the abandonment of @OnTheRecordDoc by a powerful EP or a platform to call out the betrayal of survivors by @TIMESUPNOW. Pre-Musk Twitter made a real difference. This is a loss.

@LindaBRosenthal @ejeancarroll @SafeHorizon @MHoechstetter Thank you @LindaBRosenthal @bradhoylman for sponsoring the Adult Survivors Act & @alisonturkos @EvelynYang @MHoechstetter @DonnaHylton @saraziff and all the brave survivor advocates whose advocacy made it possible for the brave @ejeancarroll to have her day in court. #MeToo

E Jean! You did it! Congratulations! I’m in awe of your grace, tenacity, vulnerability, and courage. And I’m humbled to be part of the coalition of survivors whose activism made the Adult Survivors Act possible. We’ve come full circle from last May, and #MeToo is here to stay. https://t.co/3jPRyGqLpv
Twitter galvanized the #BlackLivesMatter movement and the #MeToo movement. As a Black woman and as a survivor, I regard Musk’s destruction of this platform as a profound loss.
